turns.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS revenue FROM "public"."invoice" WHERE "invoice_date" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND "invoice_date" < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), base AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS revenue FROM "public"."invoice" WHERE "invoice_date" >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND "invoice_date" < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT cur.revenue AS current_revenue, base.revenue AS base_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base LIMIT 200
